evidence: Removes in-tree polyfills in src/util/expected.h and src/compat/byteswap.h in favor of std::expected and std::byteswap.
rationale: Retires internal utility polyfills for expected values and byteswapping in favor of standard C++23 equivalents. This simplifies core utility headers and eliminates redundant in-tree type traits, though the cleanup is reasonably deferrable.
